Landsat8.description: Landsat 8 measurements directly serve NASA research in the focus areas of climate, carbon cycle, ecosystems, water cycle, biogeochemistry, and Earth surface/interior.

Sentinel2.description: The Sentinel-2 mission systematically acquires data over land and coastal areas in a band of latitude extending from 56° South (Isla Hornos, Cape Horn, South America) to 84° North (above Greenland).
Sentinel2.spatialCoverage: France and others zones in the world

Pleiades.description: Pleaides Satellite. Pléiades is an environment-focused constellation (consisting of two satellites, referred to as 1A and 1B) from CNES of France, which were launched on 17 December 2011 (Pleiades 1A) and 2 December 2012 (Pleiades 1B).

Venus.description: Vegetation and Environment monitoring on a New Micro-Satellite is a near polar sun-synchronous orbit microsatellite. It is a joint project of the Israeli Space Agency and CNES.
